name: Quiet field
scope: Lab local preview; protocol implementation pending

rendering.frame: Closed continuous 1 CSS px outline, 50% signal opacity; no opening
rendering.corners: 5 CSS px outline arcs; prototype background outer radius 6 CSS px
rendering.tail: Tiny point; 8 CSS px base from x=17 to x=25, tip at x=21, 4 CSS px below baseline
rendering.mark: Static 8 CSS px filled signal-colored dot
rendering.escapedLogoDot: Original Off grid position (26,5), radius 2.2 in its 32x32 viewBox; header and footer
rendering.otherAccents: Full signal color for Copy glyph and escaped logo dot; action underlines at frame opacity
rendering.appearance: Follow system light/dark preference; preserve existing typography, reading width and Dots texture

integration.requiredSupport: Supported component presentation for Dot, closed bubble and tiny tail, with independent frame, field, mark and Copy colors
preserve: separate ChatGPT, Claude and Copy actions
exclude: native trials or deployment as part of design approval
